title: FieldOps Pro Remediation Playbook Front Matter
description: YAML front matter block at the head of every PLAYBOOKS/RB-*.md file. Validated by SCRIPTS/AI/FieldOps-AIClient.psm1 when a call is made with -ExpectPlaybookReference (6.5-R8), so that an AI recommendation can only cite a remediation procedure that actually exists and conforms. See PLAYBOOKS/SCHEMA.md for the authoring guide.

id.description: Stable identifier, RB-<2-4 letter category>-<3-digit serial>. Must match the filename stem: RB-AV-001 lives in RB-AV-001.md. IDs are permanent -- a retired playbook keeps its ID and is marked deprecated rather than being reused, because AI responses and audit records reference it by ID indefinitely.

title.description: Imperative summary of what the playbook does, e.g. 'Re-enable Microsoft Defender real-time protection'.

category.description: Must equal the category segment of the id. AV=anti-malware, BL=BitLocker/encryption, FW=firewall, UAC=User Account Control, WU=Windows Update, NET=networking, CRED=credentials, AUD=auditing/logging. AUD is deliberately three letters: the id pattern admits 2-4, so the design doc's original 'RB-AUDIT-*' could never have matched it.

severity.description: Severity of the condition this playbook remediates -- NOT the risk of running it. Lowercase; distinct from the client's severity classification vocabulary (6.5-R7), which describes an AI response rather than a finding.

prerequisites.description: Conditions required before the procedure can be followed, e.g. 'Administrator rights'. Optional: a playbook with no prerequisites omits the key rather than supplying an empty list.

relatedRules.description: Compliance rules this remediation satisfies, keyed by framework. Every key is optional: ANSSI is the only framework live in Phase 6.1/6.5, and the nis2/iso27001/rgs keys are carried as data ahead of Stream 6.2 activating them. A playbook written today may populate them; nothing reads them yet.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Realistic hands-on time for a competent technician. Used to sequence remediation work in a field visit; an estimate over 480 minutes indicates the procedure should be split.

revertable.description: True only if the playbook documents a complete rollback returning the machine to its prior state. This gates whether the procedure may be offered as an automated fix, so it is deliberately conservative: when in doubt, false.

deprecated.description: Set true instead of deleting a playbook whose procedure no longer applies. The ID stays resolvable so historical audit records remain interpretable, but the validator will not treat it as a valid citation for new responses.

supersededBy.description: ID of the playbook replacing this one. Only meaningful alongside deprecated: true.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS front-matter contract, not of the playbook content. Bumped only when the required-field set or a field's meaning changes.
